card.name: Words after mutual or paired actors
card.fires_on: The word right after a reciprocal or two-party action, such as 'decreased each other's' or 'affect each other'. It also fires in drug-interaction sentences where one drug acts on another's property, and weakly in stories of one person acting on another.
